summary: Pin is in bush among club halls; best stop is the street kerb to the south.
reasons: North kerb backs onto park bush
Homes face it across the road

best_section.where: North kerb of the street 40 m south-west of the pin, beside the bushy strip west of the corner

drivers.seclusion: Park bush and club buildings behind; houses on the opposite side, roughly 25 m or more across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Pin is in trees between the CWA hall and kindergarten with no tyre tracks; the street kerb is open and cars park along it.
drivers.traffic: Busy collector road beside a large signalled junction with an arterial.
drivers.convention: Several cars parked on both kerbs in both images; no campervans seen.

flags: Steep: about 5% mean grade at the pin, 9% max
Noise from the arterial junction and nearby construction
Pin is approximate; judged the kerb instead
sun_shade: Tall trees shade the north kerb, mainly in the morning from the east.
cannot_judge: Exact distance to houses across the road
